analysis: Manual dispatch only, main-only fixed repository, actor permission check, first-attempt requirement and source branch-head equality before build and before mutation.
Source npm install/test/build executes in a build job without provider or receipt-journal credentials; all checkouts disable credential persistence.
Only fixed account reads and no-override fixed-host attachment are allowed by provider transport. Worker/domain collisions and incomplete account inventory fail closed.
Artifact validation rejects executable/hidden/symlink payloads, wrong digests/revisions, deferred or extra routes, invalid canonicals/robots, missing image assets/CTAs and redirected Wrangler config.
Deploy uses fixed route-less static-asset configuration; source scripts never run with provider credentials.

HTTP verifies every reviewed route and referenced asset against the packaged SHA-256, with only one tightly identified empty Cloudflare beacon removable if the remaining bytes exactly match. Held and unknown routes must return the exact real 404.
IndexNow submission is downstream of independent public verification and uses the existing revision/site-scoped receipt journal; successful receipt is not claimed as indexing.
IndexNow-only finalization has no provider token or deployment command and does not broaden mutation scope.

independence.credentialEnvironment: Explicit non-secret allowlist; no inherited provider/GitHub credentials. Offline npm install.
independence.testHarnessAdjustment: Only two auxiliary regression harness copies had relative Node paths changed to the exact Node 22 executable; assertions and tests unchanged.
